projects.name: Ostora
projects.description: Full-stack cloud-native SaaS platform automating the end-to-end job application lifecycle. Combines AI-powered CV parsing, tailored cover letter synthesis, and real-time B2B candidate-recruiter matching over an event-driven microservices architecture.
highlights: Built asynchronous "Fast Apply" worker pools using Playwright and Kafka consumers.
Engineered AI CV parsing and dynamic cover letter synthesis tailored to job requirements.
Implemented real-time application telemetry streamed to the client via WebSockets.
Automated CI/CD deployment pipelines using Jenkins, Docker, and Terraform on AWS.
projects.architecture: Event-driven microservices orchestrated via Apache Kafka, pairing NestJS API gateways with distributed Playwright automation workers and Elasticsearch indexing on AWS Kubernetes.
projects.problem: Manual job applications and generic CVs result in low response rates, while scraping live B2B job boards at scale triggers rate limits and blocks.

technicalDecisions.reason: Modular dependency injection and strict typing across microservice boundaries.
Decouples high-volume automated application jobs from real-time user HTTP requests.
Sub-second B2B job matching and low-latency caching of candidate profiles.
Reproducible infrastructure-as-code with auto-scaling worker pods.

backendEngineering: Built asynchronous "Fast Apply" worker pools using Playwright and Kafka consumers.
Engineered AI CV parsing and dynamic cover letter synthesis tailored to job requirements.
Implemented real-time application telemetry streamed to the client via WebSockets.
Automated CI/CD deployment pipelines using Jenkins, Docker, and Terraform on AWS.

projects.name: ARCH-X7
projects.tagline: Scalable Distributed Data Extraction & Orchestration System
projects.description: ARCH-X7 is a multi-language microservices pipeline built to handle large-scale web context retrieval for LLMs and enterprise applications. Designed with extreme performance, fault tolerance, self-healing orchestration, and resource optimization at its core.
highlights: Engineered a 3-tier Redis caching engine with atomic Lua scripts and Brotli compression (-85% payload size).
Built an automated session warming pool injecting serialized Cookies and LocalStorage (<10s latency).
Decoupled API ingestion from worker execution using Kafka and RabbitMQ message brokers.
Orchestrated polyglot services (Elixir, Go, Rust, Python, C) on Kubernetes with KEDA autoscaling.
projects.architecture: Polyglot microservices pipeline combining Elixir OTP supervision, Go network recon, Rust zero-copy parsing, and a 3-tier Redis Lua caching layer decoupled via Kafka and RabbitMQ.
projects.problem: Single-language scraping pipelines collapse under enterprise WAF protections, suffer from cache stampedes under concurrent load, and block HTTP threads during slow extractions.

technicalDecisions.reason: Elixir for self-healing supervision trees, Go for fast network recon, and Rust for zero-copy HTML parsing.
Atomic Lua scripts with Soft/Hard TTLs and Brotli compression cut payload size by 85% and stop Cache Stampedes.
Zero-blocking asynchronous task queues with event-driven Kubernetes pod autoscaling.
Pre-warms and serializes Cookies/LocalStorage contexts to keep end-to-end extraction under 10s.

backendEngineering: Engineered a 3-tier Redis caching engine with atomic Lua scripts and Brotli compression (-85% payload size).
Built an automated session warming pool injecting serialized Cookies and LocalStorage (<10s latency).
Decoupled API ingestion from worker execution using Kafka and RabbitMQ message brokers.
Orchestrated polyglot services (Elixir, Go, Rust, Python, C) on Kubernetes with KEDA autoscaling.

projects.name: GamingZone
projects.tagline: E-Commerce Platform Specializing in Gaming Products (12 Microservices)
projects.description: E-commerce platform specializing in the sale of gaming products, engineered as a 12-repository distributed microservices ecosystem. Orchestrates a Next.js storefront, unified API Gateway (GraphQL & REST API), Apache Kafka event-driven order/payment/inventory sagas, Redis shopping cart & catalog caching, shared TypeScript domain contracts, and automated Jenkins Groovy + Docker CI/CD infrastructure.
highlights: Architected a 12-repository distributed microservices ecosystem (Storefront, API Gateway, Payment, Order, Cart, Inventory, Catalog, Shared Lib, User Profile, Notification, Auth, Infrastructure).
Implemented event-driven Saga choreography over Apache Kafka between Order, Inventory, Payment, and Notification microservices.
Engineered ultra-low-latency Redis shopping cart state and catalog caching behind a unified GraphQL & REST API Gateway.
Automated multi-service container builds and CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins declarative Groovy pipelines and Docker.
projects.problem: Monolithic gaming e-commerce stores buckle under flash-sale traffic spikes, suffer from inventory race conditions during concurrent checkouts, and create deployment bottlenecks when scaling catalog, cart, and payment modules independently.
projects.architecture: 12-repository distributed microservices architecture fronted by Next.js and a unified API Gateway (GraphQL + REST), backed by Redis cart/inventory caching, Apache Kafka event streams, shared TypeScript domain contracts, and Jenkins Groovy CI/CD.

technicalDecisions.reason: Independent service lifecycles and deployments while enforcing strict TypeScript DTO and event contracts via gamingzone-shared-lib.
Asynchronous order-to-payment-to-inventory reservation sagas and real-time customer notifications without blocking checkout HTTP threads.
Unified edge routing combining flexible GraphQL storefront queries with high-throughput REST endpoints.
Automated CI/CD infrastructure pipelines and sub-millisecond Redis cart & stock lookups during peak gaming drops.

backendEngineering: Architected a 12-repository distributed microservices ecosystem (Storefront, API Gateway, Payment, Order, Cart, Inventory, Catalog, Shared Lib, User Profile, Notification, Auth, Infrastructure).
Implemented event-driven Saga choreography over Apache Kafka between Order, Inventory, Payment, and Notification microservices.
Engineered ultra-low-latency Redis shopping cart state and catalog caching behind a unified GraphQL & REST API Gateway.
Automated multi-service container builds and CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins declarative Groovy pipelines and Docker.

projects.name: scanOCR
projects.tagline: Advanced Identity Document Analysis & Biometric Extraction
projects.description: Offline-first computer vision pipeline engineered for automated identity document verification. Extracts biometric facial regions, MRZ (Machine Readable Zone) codes, and multilingual fields using spatial zone recognition and deep OCR models without external API dependencies.
highlights: Built an offline-first document processing pipeline with zero external network dependencies.
Implemented automated image deskewing, adaptive thresholding, and spatial zone cropping.
Extracted and validated ICAO MRZ lines alongside multilingual personal fields.
Isolated biometric facial portraits and signatures with automated quality scoring.
projects.architecture: 100% offline computer vision pipeline: OpenCV perspective deskewing and Canny contour isolation feeding into spatial zone segmentation and PaddleOCR deep recognition.
projects.problem: Cloud OCR APIs introduce privacy risks for sensitive identity documents, fail in air-gapped environments, and struggle with tilted mobile scans and ICAO MRZ checksums.

technicalDecisions.reason: Automated perspective correction, noise reduction, and document boundary isolation.
High-accuracy multilingual character recognition running locally without external API calls.
Fast local biometric portrait and signature region extraction.
Deterministic checksum verification on Machine Readable Zones (MRZ) to eliminate OCR hallucinations.

backendEngineering: Built an offline-first document processing pipeline with zero external network dependencies.
Implemented automated image deskewing, adaptive thresholding, and spatial zone cropping.
Extracted and validated ICAO MRZ lines alongside multilingual personal fields.
Isolated biometric facial portraits and signatures with automated quality scoring.

projects.name: Eventra
projects.description: Designed and developed a full-stack event management and ticketing platform using Next.js, React, TypeScript, NestJS, GraphQL, MongoDB, and Redis — structured around strict Clean Architecture principles.
highlights: Separated Presentation, Application, Domain, and Infrastructure layers following Clean Architecture.
Enforced domain-level business rules for reservation eligibility, live capacity limits, and cancellations.
Built automated PDFKit + QR code ticket generation and role-based access control (Passport + JWT).
Integrated Redis caching for expensive operations and automated CI/CD checks with Docker & GitHub Actions.
projects.architecture: Strict 4-layer Clean Architecture (Presentation, Application, Domain, Infrastructure) with a NestJS + GraphQL backend, MongoDB persistence, Redis caching, and automated PDF/QR ticketing.
projects.problem: Traditional event platforms suffer from tightly coupled booking logic, slow repeated queries during peak ticket sales, and manual ticket validation bottlenecks.

technicalDecisions.reason: Isolates core domain rules (capacity, eligibility, cancellations) from framework and database details.
Strongly-typed schema resolvers allowing flexible client queries without over-fetching.
Caches high-traffic event listings and expensive aggregations for sub-millisecond reads.
Generates downloadable, cryptographically verifiable passes immediately upon booking confirmation.

backendEngineering: Separated Presentation, Application, Domain, and Infrastructure layers following Clean Architecture.
Enforced domain-level business rules for reservation eligibility, live capacity limits, and cancellations.
Built automated PDFKit + QR code ticket generation and role-based access control (Passport + JWT).
Integrated Redis caching for expensive operations and automated CI/CD checks with Docker & GitHub Actions.

projects.name: HealthPulse
projects.description: Resilient backend system engineered for clinical and medical facility management. Features asynchronous job queues for medical report processing, S3-compatible object storage for diagnostic imaging, and strict role-based access control for patient data privacy.
highlights: Engineered asynchronous background workers with Bull Queue and Redis for non-blocking clinical workflows.
Integrated MinIO object storage with secure pre-signed URLs for medical imaging and lab reports.
Implemented multi-role RBAC middleware and JWT authentication protecting patient endpoints.
Containerized the entire stack with Docker and validated endpoints with automated Jest test suites.
projects.architecture: Layered RESTful backend powered by Node.js and Express, offloading heavy tasks to Redis-backed Bull job queues and storing encrypted clinical documents in self-hosted MinIO S3 vaults.
projects.problem: Clinical systems face blocked HTTP threads during heavy medical report generation, insecure storage of diagnostic files, and weak permission boundaries around patient data.

technicalDecisions.reason: Offloads heavy PDF report generation and appointment notifications to non-blocking background workers.
Self-hosted S3-compatible vault with time-limited pre-signed URLs for sensitive diagnostic files.
Fast patient medical history queries and conflict-free appointment slot lookups.
Enforces strict access isolation between Doctors, Receptionists, Patients, and Admins.

backendEngineering: Engineered asynchronous background workers with Bull Queue and Redis for non-blocking clinical workflows.
Integrated MinIO object storage with secure pre-signed URLs for medical imaging and lab reports.
Implemented multi-role RBAC middleware and JWT authentication protecting patient endpoints.
Containerized the entire stack with Docker and validated endpoints with automated Jest test suites.

projects.name: Walletly
projects.description: Developed a full-stack personal finance application using Node.js, Express, MySQL, Sequelize, and EJS, structured around a layered MVC, Service, and Repository architecture for multi-wallet tracking, budgeting, and visual analytics.
highlights: Structured the backend into distinct Controller, Service, and Repository layers over Sequelize ORM.
Built multi-wallet balance tracking, monthly category budgets, and automated savings goal calculations.
Implemented searchable, filterable transaction histories and aggregated endpoints for Chart.js.
Secured user sessions with bcrypt password hashing, Joi schema validation, and Docker Compose.
projects.architecture: Layered MVC application with dedicated Service and Repository patterns, backed by relational MySQL + Sequelize schemas, Joi validation, and interactive Chart.js analytics.
projects.problem: Managing personal finances across multiple accounts without structured category budgets, transaction search, or visual cash-flow breakdowns leads to poor spending visibility.

technicalDecisions.reason: Cleanly separates HTTP routing, financial calculation logic, and Sequelize database queries.
ACID-compliant relational transactions for multi-wallet balances, budgets, and savings goals.
Strict server-side payload validation and hardened session-based authentication.
Renders interactive monthly category burndown and income-vs-expense analytics.

backendEngineering: Structured the backend into distinct Controller, Service, and Repository layers over Sequelize ORM.

projects.name: Loughat
projects.description: Developed a full-featured e-learning platform using Laravel, PHP, MySQL, and Blade, connecting students and teachers through structured course management, enrollment, payment abstraction, and interactive learning workflows.
highlights: Implemented 3-tier role authorization for Administrators, Teachers (with approval workflows), and Students.
Engineered order and payment processing using the Strategy Pattern and Stripe SDK.
Enforced domain purchase-eligibility rules before allowing course or teacher reviews.
Integrated Cloudinary for media management and validated core flows with PHPUnit in Docker/Sail.
projects.architecture: Laravel MVC architecture enhanced with the Repository Pattern for data access and the Strategy Pattern for pluggable payment providers, paired with Cloudinary CDN and MySQL.
projects.problem: E-learning platforms require strict multi-role workflows (Admin, Teacher, Student), flexible payment gateway integration, and verified review rules tied to actual course enrollment.

technicalDecisions.reason: Decouples checkout workflows from Stripe SDK so payment providers can be swapped seamlessly.
Abstracts complex relational queries across courses, sections, lessons, and enrollments.
Offloads course video and media storage with automated transcoding and fast delivery.
Separates Admin vetting, Teacher course builders, and Student learning portals with automated tests.

backendEngineering: Implemented 3-tier role authorization for Administrators, Teachers (with approval workflows), and Students.

projects.name: MediLink AI
projects.description: AI-powered oncology care bridge developed during the YouCode × Sofrecom Hackathon. Coordinates three specialized AI agents (Report Simplification, Emotional Distress Detection, and Clinical Alert Triage) to connect cancer patients with medical teams in real time.

Built medical report simplification workflows translating clinical jargon into clear patient guidance.
Implemented automated distress and symptom detection that escalates priority alerts to doctors.
Shipped the functional prototype during the YouCode × Sofrecom Hackathon.
projects.architecture: Multi-agent AI backend coordinating three specialized agents — Report Simplification, Empathy & Distress Detection, and Clinical Alert Escalation — between patients and oncologists.
projects.problem: Cancer patients struggle to understand complex pathology reports at home, while medical teams lack real-time triage alerts when patients experience acute physical or emotional distress.

technicalDecisions.reason: Separates medical translation, emotional support, and clinical risk scoring into specialized prompts.
Low-latency REST orchestration routing patient inputs across the AI agent pipeline.
Flags high-risk symptoms immediately and dispatches structured alerts to clinicians.
Gives medical teams an immediate overview of patient distress signals and simplified summaries.

projects.name: TrackRoute
projects.description: Full-stack trailer and fleet tracking platform engineered with strict Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) principles in TypeScript, Node.js, Express.js, and React. Provides real-time trailer dispatch, route lifecycle tracking, maintenance status monitoring, and RESTful telemetry APIs.
highlights: Designed an Object-Oriented domain model in TypeScript encapsulating trailer states, route legs, and driver assignments.
Built RESTful Express.js APIs for real-time trailer tracking, dispatch scheduling, and fleet availability.
Developed an interactive React.js operations dashboard for monitoring active routes and cargo status.
Enforced clean encapsulation, polymorphic domain services, and strict TypeScript compile-time safety.
projects.problem: Logistics operators lose visibility over trailer locations, route checkpoints, and maintenance readiness when relying on fragmented spreadsheets or procedural backend scripts.
projects.architecture: Object-Oriented TypeScript backend over Node.js and Express.js exposing strongly-typed RESTful APIs to a real-time React.js fleet dispatch and trailer telemetry dashboard.

technicalDecisions.reason: Encapsulates complex trailer state transitions (Idle, In-Transit, Maintenance) and route rules inside rich domain classes.
Clean resource-oriented endpoints for trailers, routes, checkpoints, and dispatch logs.
Responsive logistics control panel for real-time fleet filtering and route assignment.
